findings.evidence: The assignment explicitly records executor serving family as KHONG_DO_DUOC. ACP model selection and process linkage establish configuration and transport limits, not served inference family. No independent audited family attestation or exact-H7 human audit was supplied. ADR-0065 permits provider-derived family for Codex, but gives no unique family mapping for Antigravity.
findings.recommendation: Fix: Preserve the frozen product bytes. Supply same-session serving-family evidence, or an independently audited family attestation explicitly labelled weaker than machine measurement. Alternatively obtain a protocol-compliant independent human audit of the exact H7/spec/diff. Dispatcher publication identity and owner packaging approval cannot substitute for that audit. Test: Bind evidence to the executor session and frozen source hashes, then verify that configuration-only evidence, absent audit identity, and mismatched session/SHA are rejected. No additional model call is authorized by this receipt. Regression risk: Relabelling configured Gemini settings or the GitHub submitter as serving proof/human audit would create false cross_approved assurance.

findings.evidence: The full-selftest result records only head, rc and duration. The manifest binds the supplied log, and its 1777/1777 main and 12/12 nested markers were verified. However, the original command argv and runner/OS/Python runtime identity are absent from the supplied execution evidence. Protocol §10.1 requires those identities before reuse. The independent admission attempt also could not complete because the read-only sandbox has no usable temporary directory.
findings.recommendation: Fix: Recover the original H7 full-selftest execution record outside the product checkout, including actual command, checkout SHA/tree/base, runner/OS/runtime, relevant code identities, rc and output hash. If unavailable, an authorized runner must produce complete evidence on unchanged H7. Provide scratch capability for canonical admission or retain a complete independently verifiable original admission execution record. Test: Validate recovered evidence against H7/tree/S7 and log SHA256 3352113dca96b876d651899d76163e56bc0bbc32359d7e74bfd2db3dd10e9f06. Missing runtime fields, stale SHA or altered output hash must prevent reuse. Canonical admission must complete with rc0 and its positive marker. Regression risk: Backfilling historical execution metadata from the current reviewer environment would falsely certify an unobserved run. Avoid repeating the heavy suite if the original complete receipt can be recovered.
